title: Haughton Mars Project simulation and Chris McKay lecture

tellings.quote: we essentially played like we were Mars astronauts and my role was the robot guy

plain: In 2001, at Haughton Crater on Devon Island, a group of scientists rehearsed a Mars mission on the ground. The robotics scientist John Blitch took part and tells Michels about it: "we essentially played like we were Mars astronauts and my role was the robot guy." He names others who were involved, Chris McKay (who gave a lecture there), Pascal Lee, Bob Zubrin, Darlene Lim and the filmmaker James Cameron, and tells it as part of how he came to think about humans and machines in strange places.
